recentItems.title: NFS Unbound: Vol. 9 Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description:
Ride or die with your crew in Vol.9: Prepare for Lockdown*, one of our most high-stakes mode yet, taking the NFS risk reward formula to new heights and continuing our quest to deliver the most complete NFS experience in one place for the first time, with the addition of this all-new PvPvE multiplayer mode. 

Break into Lockups with your crew, using bikes for the first time in NFS history. 

Claim the Hot Rides inside, including Racer X’s Custom BMW M3 GTR ‘05 and 14 rides inspired by Most Wanted's Blacklist and more! 

Escape the Lockdown Zone by claiming the Extraction Truck, and you get to keep them to use across Free Roam, PVP and Lockdown, alongside the new fully customizable SUBARU Impreza WRX STI ’99 and Honda Integra Type R ’98 from the Speedpass**. 

PVP is refreshed with motorbikes, NFS 30 Year anniversary celebration and drift pro playlists. Volume 9 also comes with a new Speed Pass, and an optional Premium track offering a total of 75 tiers of unlockable content. Developed by Criterion Games and published by Electronic Arts, with release on November 26th. 

*Requires NFS Unbound (sold separately) and all game updates to play
** Premium Speedpass entitlement required for Honda Integra Type R ‘98

Follow us everywhere 👉 https://linktree.com/needforspeed

recentItems.title: Need for Speed Unbound - VOL 3 Content Update Trailer
recentItems.description:
LINKUP, RANK UP, GEAR UP

Get ready to work together to crush intense stunt-based challenges against the clock, as Need for Speed™ Unbound Vol 3 (arriving June 20, 2023) brings new ways to earn XP and Bank. Elevate your style and rank up with Speed Pass, a new system rewarding progression with 75 free cosmetics and customizations, and show the streets what you’re about with new premium content in the Store including the mecha-themed Robojets Swag Pack, a Legendary Custom Ford Mustang GT (2015) with a 10-level Speed Pass boost, and a Vol 3 Customs Pack*.

Get your first look at the new Chat Wheel that gives you new ways to communicate quickly with the Lakeshore community, the Daily and Weekly Challenges you’ll complete to rank up and grab the goods you need to light up the streets with your style, and more!

* Requires Need for Speed Unbound (sold separately), all game updates, internet connection & an EA Account.

recentItems.title: Need for Speed Unbound - VOL 2 Content Update Trailer
recentItems.description:
The evolution of Lakeshore Online begins... Tear up the streets with friends as Need for Speed Unbound brings new ways to compare and compete in Lakeshore Online, with the first free content update starting March 21st.
The streets of Lakeshore just got hotter! Hit up your homies for exhilarating cop chases through the streets and battle it out on packed grids in brand-new Rumble and Endurance races introducing more opportunities for you to risk it all for some crazy new rewards!
Return to the city every day for 3 new Daily Challenges and receive XP and Bank in return. Take part in new Playlist events, or put your pace to the test in new Hot Laps circuits to earn “The Ultimate Luxury” ride or take home a new Custom Build, the Lotus Emira Balmain Edition 2021.
Want to build Bank faster? Cut straight to the chase and unlock all collectibles and activities in every district across Lakeshore thanks to the new Keys To The Map DLC!*

* Requires Need for Speed Unbound (sold separately), all game updates, internet connection & an EA Account.

recentItems.title: Need for Speed™ Heat Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
WARNING: Includes flashing images

Join the wave of over 100,000 players who have already received a unique and personalized NFS Heat Launch Trailer. Get yours by visiting https://www.ea.com/games/need-for-speed/need-for-speed-heat/heatwave before November 8th and watch your customized ride burn up the streets of Palm City.

In NFS Heat earn bank by day to create your perfect ride through sanctioned Speedhunters Showdown events. By night, enter illicit street races alongside your crew, earning rep and building heat. But stay ready – cops are waiting and not all of them play fair. The roads and the rides are endless in this twenty-four-hour street racer where only the fast are free to chase the line, risk everything and burn all limits.
 
This trailer was created using the innovative Need for Speed™ Heat Studio App - download now, collect all the available models, create your perfect ride and connect it to Need for Speed™ Heat.
